children: Circle’s website shows that USDC issued about 11.4 billion tokens and redeemed about 9.9 billion in the week ending September 24 local time, leaving circulating supply up by about 1.5 billion tokens. According to Foresight News, USDC circulation stood at about 75.2 billion tokens as of September 24 local time, while reserve assets were valued at about $75.5 billion.

title: USDC Circulating Supply Rises by About 1.5 Billion in One Week
